question: Has gap G001 already been addressed: No retrieved work establishes whether passage-local context-triple supervision improves multi-hop KGQA at matched supervision volume, with an evaluation set the repair loop cannot edit, and with seed-level variance reported. The closest work size-matches the two disease KGs against each other (not the KG-grounded vs CG-grounded training arms), uses unequal numbers of repair examples across error categories, removes invalid triples from and regenerates validation questions in the set it reports 100% accuracy on, and evaluates only on synthetically generated items; separately, work on subgraph retrieval shows larger context adds noise. Consequently the causal claim (context content rather than more training signal) and the repair claim (repair rather than evaluation-set selection) are both unestablished.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
